Name: passive-named-turns
Description: Three passive agents in a room with one person. Each question names one agent; only that agent is addressed, takes the floor, and answers. Turns alternate cleanly with the human between them.

Events.Text: Sage, can you summarize the quarterly numbers?
Revenue grew eight percent over the prior quarter, led by renewals.
Thanks. Demo Loop, what is the pipeline outlook?
Pipeline coverage is three point two times target going into next quarter.
